experience.details:
Designated project: UNOCHA, DFAT (Provide assistance for all 12 projects including internationally funded projects: ECHO HIP, DANIDA, POSNER, SONY, Telethon, UNICEF etc.)
Major responsibilities:
GIS Mapping: Visualizing CP facilities and service stations on GIS based maps, population density mapping, camp and host community mapping, disaster affected area mapping, DRR implementation area mapping, LULCC mapping etc.
Database management: Managing and updating major databases including: Activity Tracker (Monthly analysis of beneficiaries attended training, meeting, session etc.), Group Tracker (Total number of groups and participants), Enrollment Tracker (Total number of beneficiaries enrolled in MPCAC facilities), CPIMS+ (A broad database that records number of cases - neglect, abuse, harassment, exploitation, child marriage etc.), Case Management Tracker (Number of beneficiaries faces different cases, a monthly record by each case worker), CP Facility Database (Data records of child protection facility offices, including GPS location, camp, block number etc.)
MEAL assistance: IPTT reporting (Providing indicator wise beneficiary count to the MEAL team), Reach reporting (Grant wise and at a glance reach to total beneficiaries), 5W reporting (providing sub sector required data), assist the MEAL team in baseline and endline questionnaire tool development.
Data assessment: Monthly assessment of data through verifying with hardcopies and Kobo datasets, regular communication with field staff regarding data validation, assessment and problem solving.
Other reports:
Factsheets: Providing grant-wise and at a glance progress by visualizing data for activities, cases, groups, facilities etc.
Qualitative reports: Providing qualitative reports through thematic analysis of KII, FGD, IDI data.

experience.institution: Bangladesh Institute of Innovative Health Research - BIIHR
experience.details:
Location: Dhaka, Bangladesh
Main responsibilities:
Literature review: Narrative review, systematic review, etc.
Terms of Reference: Developing TOR, research proposals etc.
Questionnaire tool development: Experienced in DASS-21, 24/7 recall, SRBS questionnaires etc.
Data collection: Guiding the data enumerators for data collection.
Data analysis: Performing qualitative and quantitative data analysis using statistical software.
Reporting: Research manuscript writing, review paper writing etc.
Management: Supervised a team of five research assistants in an environmental health project, organizing regular team meetings and discussions.
Presentation: Presenting major research outcomes in conferences and seminars.
